name: tbhk-app
description: Turtle Beach Huts Karachi — native wrappers (Android / iOS via Capacitor, Windows / macOS / Linux via Electron)

scripts.cap:add:android: npm run sync-web && npx cap add android
scripts.cap:add:ios: npm run sync-web && npx cap add ios
scripts.cap:sync: npm run sync-web && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:android: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.cap:ios: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open ios
